description:
Get exclusive videos & early access on my Patreon: http://patreon.com/RyanGeorge

Hi there hello.

Today we’re heading to California to take a calm and respectful look at some luxury homes that absolutely make sense and are designed by people who definitely live in reality.

From million-dollar Airbnbs that may or may not be communes, to properties that come with zebras for some reason, to houses with cars in the living room and vodka tasting freezers, we’re exploring what happens when too much money meets too many ideas.

Some of these homes are impressive.
Some are confusing.
Some are both.
